_note: Vietnam — Round 7 — browser/curl unblock of the access-blocked backlog, 2026-08-29. Every edge here closes a lead that an earlier round recorded as unreachable. The blocks were largely artefacts of the fetch tool, not the sites: mnd.gov.tw is fully readable to plain curl (its 'ROBOTS_DISALLOWED' verdict was WebFetch obeying robots.txt); gob.mx serves its /cms/uploads/attachment/file/ PDFs to curl while Akamai-challenging its HTML; BPS Indonesia's signed web-api.bps.go.id download host is not Cloudflare-walled even though every *.bps.go.id page is. Every quote below was verified verbatim against the fetched bytes (pdftotext/substring match), not against a search snippet or a fetch-tool summary. See project memory unlinked_nodes_wiring_round7_2026-08-29 for the full narrative.

dependencies.basis: The survey plan for the 2024 Survey on the Socio-Economic Situation of the 53 Ethnic Minorities, issued under GSO Decision 628/QĐ-TCTK, sets its enumeration rule by reference to the results of the 2019 Population and Housing Census: ethnic minorities whose nationwide population is under 10,000 per the 2019 census are completely enumerated rather than sampled. Verbatim: "Riêng đối với dân tộc thiểu số có quy mô dân số dưới 10.000 người trên toàn quốc theo kết quả Tổng điều tra dân số và nhà ở năm 2019, sẽ tiến hành điều tra toàn bộ những hộ thuộc nhóm dân tộc thiểu số này tại địa bàn vùng dân tộc thiểu số." Confirmed by exact substring match on two independent carriers: the GSO Cao Bang provincial office page cited here, which introduces itself as Tổng cục Thống kê xin giới thiệu... and names Quyết định số 628/QĐ-TCTK; and the full text of that Decision at luatvietnam.vn, where the identical sentence sits under section III. LOẠI ĐIỀU TRA followed by the two-stage stratified sample design. Typed methodology_depends_on rather than uses_data_from because what the sentence governs is the enumeration and sample design, not the survey's published figures. The provincial subdomain is used as evidence_url because GSO's own www.gso.gov.vn and www.nso.gov.vn die at the TLS handshake from every route tried.
